description: Create a Pickly poll to help a group decide something together (where to eat, which date, what to watch) and get a link to share in the group chat. Nobody needs an account to vote.

allowSuggestions.description: Let voters suggest more options. Nothing joins the poll until the creator approves it (review_suggestion, or the manage link).

allowVoterEmails.description: Let voters leave an email address to get the results when voting closes.

closesInHours.description: When voting closes, in hours from when it opens. Defaults to 24.

description.description: Optional extra context shown under the question.

maxChoices.description: multi polls only: how many options each person may tick. Leave out for no limit.

opensAt.description: When voting opens, as an ISO 8601 date-time with the person's UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-07T18:00:00+01:00. Leave out to open right away. The link works before then, but voting stays locked.

optionKind.description: What every option is: a named thing, a calendar date, a time of day, or a place.

options.description: 2 to 20 options, all of the optionKind.

address.description: Place options: the place's own address, e.g. a restaurant's street address.

note.description: Date and time options: a short note, e.g. "after work".

time.description: Time options: HH:MM, 24-hour. Optional on date options.

title.description: The option's name. Needed for text and place options.

url.description: Text and place options: an http(s) link, e.g. a menu or a listing.

password.description: A password voters type before they can open the poll. Only when the person asks for one; they share it with the link.

question.description: What the group is deciding, e.g. "Where do we eat on Friday?"

resultsEmail.description: The creator's own email address, to get the results when voting closes. Only when they give it and ask for that. Needs a closing time, so not with stayOpen.

showVoters.description: true shows who voted what: voters pick their name from voterNames, and everyone sees each person's answers. Leave out (or false) for anonymous votes, the default. Use it when the person wants to see who voted for what.

stayOpen.description: Keep voting open until the creator closes it (close_poll, or the manage link) instead of closing at a set time.

voterNames.description: With showVoters: the names of everyone who can vote, e.g. the people in the group chat. Only they can vote, each name once.

votingStyle.description: How people vote. multi: tick every option that works (the default, good for most choices). ranked: put the options in order; an instant runoff picks the winner. score: 1 to 5 stars each. swipe: yes or no per option, one card at a time. availability: yes, if need be, or no per option; best for finding a date that suits everyone.
